text:
Iris: dropping a new compare prototype  introduces a 'heat' performance badge (color gradient) and filter-presets in the header. Questions: 1) Are gradient badges ok for quick scan? 2) Where to expose version pinning: inline dropdown vs right-rail? Screenshot: <link>
Paul: Heat gradient looks nice but colors alone are ambiguous. Need numeric label and aria-label. Consider prefixing with a tiny icon to indicate low/med/high.
Jun: Agree. Also keep plain text under the badge, e.g. "Latency p95: 34ms". For colorblind folks use icon+pattern fallback or an explicit numeric label.
Kareem: Pinning  prefer inline kebab menu with a "Pin version" action + a persistent "Pinned" area in the header showing current pins. If we allow multi-pin, we need a compare tray count and CTA.
Iris: What about storing pins as part of "filter-presets" so teams can save curated views? Could be handy for Platform teams.
Paul: API note: expose /orgs/:org_id/presets and /users/:user_id/pins. Ensure private deployments can sync pins via org-level setting.
A11yBot: Accessibility: gradient badges reduce text contrast and are problematic for screen readers. Ensure visible numeric text meets 4.5:1 contrast; add solid outline or fallback solid bg. Provide aria-label like "Latency p95 34ms, tested on lm-bench-v2". Gradient alone is not sufficient.
Jun: Keyboard flow: pinned list reachable via header shortcut, focus order consistent, and add aria-live region for pin/unpin snackbar. Undo action should be keyboard accessible.
Kareem: Microcopy: change "Save preset" -> "Save filter preset"; badge copy must be explicit: "Latency (p95): 34ms". Hover/tap reveals dataset + workload.
Iris: Decision summary: 1) Keep gradient for glanceability but always show numeric label + icon and have accessible fallback (solid bg or outline); 2) Pin via kebab + pinned header area + support saving pins into filter-presets; 3) Persist compare mode per-user via /users/:id/preferences; 4) Show snackbar with undo and aria-live; 5) Add a11y checklist and colorblind-safe palette in the ticket. I'll update Figma and tag eng. :thumbsup:
Paul: I'll draft the API contract and include example payloads for presets/pins.
Jun: Added a11y test cases to the ticket and will add screen-reader strings. :white_check_mark:
